purpose: Verified contract for translating citizen language into search and evidence-routing dimensions.
interpretation_rule: Natural-language interpretation routes the question; it does not establish facts or legal conclusions.
clarification_rule: Ask only for information that materially changes search scope, evidence selection or property/date identity.
property_rule: Property-specific searches require identity checks before property-specific conclusions.
temporal_rule: Current and historical questions are routed separately.
compound_rule: Material compound questions are split into linked sub-searches without discarding the original request.
verification_boundary: The resolver selects search/evidence routes; it does not establish the underlying property or legal facts.
